scripts.docker:test:db: docker compose run --build --rm modern-api-test; status=$?; docker compose down -v; exit $status
scripts.docker:test:modern-db: docker compose run --build --rm modern-api-test; status=$?; docker compose down -v; exit $status
scripts.docker:test:proxy: docker compose run --build --rm app-modern-proxy-test; status=$?; docker compose down -v; exit $status
scripts.docker:test:all-db: npm run docker:test:modern-db && npm run docker:test:proxy
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix dtoapi ci && npm --prefix dtoapi/modern ci
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:app
scripts.test:proxy:modern: npm --prefix dtoapi/modern run build && node test/app_modern_proxy_test.js
